sections.overview:
The redesigned-pancake skill is an automation tool maintained by Sfedfcv that manages CI/CD pipeline configuration and documentation. It handles Travis CI migration workflows and integrates with GitHub's action-based deployment system. The skill coordinates multiple branches and pull requests to streamline continuous integration setup across projects.
Migrate legacy Travis CI configurations to modern GitHub Actions
Automate CI/CD pipeline documentation updates across repositories
Manage multi-branch merge workflows for infrastructure changes
Coordinate allowed-actions configurations for GitHub security policies
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Sfedfcv/redesigned-pancake`
